text: {"question": "How was chronic kidney disease (CKD) status operationally defined in this study among patients with type 2 diabetes?", "answer": "Patients were classified as having CKD if their registry-derived estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR), calculated using the CKD-EPI formula, was less than 60 mL/min/1.73 m².", "evidence": "Patients were operationally classified as having CKD if the available registry-derived eGFR was <60 mL/min/1.73 m²."}
